# DTCloudOn

> DTCloudOn (Sunrise Correlation LLC) is a managed IT services and cybersecurity provider for small and mid-sized businesses across the United States, serving clients in all 50 states both remotely and on-site.

DTCloudOn provides managed IT support, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365 administration, network engineering, cloud services, IT procurement and IT consulting. Industry pages describe how these services apply to specific sectors.

## Industries

- [Managed IT Services for Accounting Firms](https://dtcloudon.com/industries/accounting.html): IT support and cybersecurity for CPA firms and tax preparers, including technical safeguards for the FTC Safeguards Rule (GLBA), IRS Publication 4557 and WISP implementation; supports QuickBooks, Sage and Drake Tax.

## Services

- [Managed IT Services](https://dtcloudon.com/services/managed-services.html): Monitoring, maintenance, help desk and day-to-day IT management.
- [Cybersecurity](https://dtcloudon.com/services/cybersecurity.html): Endpoint protection, email security, MFA, encryption and security monitoring.
- [Network Services](https://dtcloudon.com/services/network.html): Network design, engineering and support, including on-site structured cabling nationwide.
- Access control systems: On-site installation and support of badge readers and door access control, nationwide.

## On-site services (all 50 states)

- On-site server installation and configuration: Rack-mounting, setup and configuration of physical servers, including operating systems, virtualization, storage and file servers.
- On-site network equipment installation: Installation and configuration of switches, routers and firewalls.
- Wireless network design and installation: Wireless site surveys and installation of Wi-Fi access points for full office coverage.
- On-site structured network cabling: Installation, termination, labeling and testing of Ethernet cabling and network drops for workstations, printers and other office devices.
- On-site access control systems: Installation and support of badge readers and door access control systems.
- Security camera installation: Installation and configuration of IP security cameras and video recording systems.
- VoIP phone system installation: Deployment of VoIP desk phones and business phone systems.
- Server room and network rack build-outs: Rack installation, cable management, UPS battery backup and power for server rooms and network closets.
- Workstation, printer and peripheral deployment: On-site setup of computers, printers, scanners and other office equipment.
- Office moves and IT relocations: Planning, disconnection, transport coordination and reinstallation of IT equipment when an office moves or expands.
- On-site troubleshooting and hardware repair: Technician visits to diagnose and fix hardware, network and connectivity problems that cannot be resolved remotely.
- Network site surveys and assessments: On-site evaluation of existing network, cabling and equipment to plan upgrades and identify problems.
- [IT Procurement](https://dtcloudon.com/services/it-procurement.html): Sourcing and installing business hardware and software.
